versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
controles.kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
controles.livre: Toma a conta dos filhos de Coate dentre os filhos de Levi, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais,

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־בָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: De idade de trinta anos acima até cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֛את עֲבֹדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, the most holy things.
controles.kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
controles.livre: Este será o ofício dos filhos de Coate no tabernáculo do testemunho, no lugar santíssimo:

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֨א אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהוֹרִ֕דוּ אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֑ךְ וְכִ֨סּוּ־בָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת׃

controles.web: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
controles.kjv: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
controles.livre: Quando se houver de mudar o acampamento, virão Arão e seus filhos, e desarmarão o véu da tenda, e cobrirão com ele a arca do testemunho:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּסוּי֙ ע֣וֹר תַּ֔חַשׁ וּפָרְשׂ֧וּ בֶֽגֶד־כְּלִ֛יל תְּכֵ֖לֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂמ֖וּ בַּדָּֽיו׃

controles.web: and shall put a covering of sealskin on it, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.
controles.kjv: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
controles.livre: E porão sobre ela a coberta de peles finas, e estenderão encima o pano todo de azul, e lhe porão suas varas.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ שֻׁלְחַ֣ן הַפָּנִ֗ים יִפְרְשׂוּ֮ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵלֶת֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָיו אֶת־הַקְּעָרֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַכַּפֹּת֙ וְאֶת־הַמְּנַקִּיֹּ֔ת וְאֵ֖ת קְשׂ֣וֹת הַנָּ֑סֶךְ וְלֶ֥חֶם הַתָּמִ֖יד עָלָ֥יו יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
controles.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
controles.livre: E sobre a mesa da proposição estenderão o pano azul, e porão sobre ela os pratos, e as colheres, e os copos, e as taças para fazer libações: e o pão contínuo estará sobre ela.

versos.hebraico: וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם בֶּ֚גֶד תּוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת־בַּדָּֽיו׃

controles.web: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
controles.kjv: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
controles.livre: E estenderão sobre ela o pano de carmesim colorido, e o cobrirão com a coberta de peles finas; e lhe porão suas varas.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקְח֣וּ׀ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֗לֶת וְכִסּ֞וּ אֶת־מְנֹרַ֤ת הַמָּאוֹר֙ וְאֶת־נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־מַלְקָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־מַחְתֹּתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־כְּלֵ֣י שַׁמְנָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְתוּ־לָ֖הּ בָּהֶֽם׃

controles.web: “They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lamp stand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
controles.kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
controles.livre: E tomarão um pano azul, e cobrirão o candelabro da luminária; e suas lâmpadas, e suas tenazes, e seus apagadores, e todos os seus vasos do azeite com que se serve;

versos.hebraico: וְנָתְנ֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלֶ֔יהָ אֶל־מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל־הַמּֽוֹט׃

controles.web: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
controles.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
controles.livre: E o porão com todos os seus utensílios em uma coberta de peles finos, e o colocarão sobre umas armações.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֗ב יִפְרְשׂוּ֙ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת־בַּדָּֽיו׃

controles.web: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
controles.kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
controles.livre: E sobre o altar de ouro estenderão o pano azul, e lhe cobrirão com a coberta de peles finas, e lhe porão suas varas.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקְחוּ֩ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֨י הַשָּׁרֵ֜ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ־בָ֣ם בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ וְנָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶל־בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל־הַמּֽוֹט׃

controles.web: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
controles.kjv: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:
controles.livre: E tomarão todos os vasos do serviço, de que fazem uso no santuário, e os porão em um pano azul, e os cobrirão com uma coberta de peles finas, e os colocarão sobre umas armações.

versos.hebraico: וְדִשְּׁנ֖וּ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֔יו בֶּ֖גֶד אַרְגָּמָֽן׃

controles.web: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
controles.kjv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
controles.livre: E tirarão a cinza do altar, e estenderão sobre ele um pano de púrpura:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָיו אֶֽת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֞יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְֽשָׁרְת֧וּ עָלָ֣יו בָּהֶ֗ם אֶת־הַמַּחְתֹּ֤ת אֶת־הַמִּזְלָגֹת֙ וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּס֛וּי ע֥וֹר תַּ֖חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֥וּ בַדָּֽיו׃

controles.web: They shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the flesh hooks, the shovels, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
controles.kjv: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.
controles.livre: E porão sobre ele todos os seus instrumentos de que se serve: as pás, os garfos, os braseiros, e as taças, todos os utensílios do altar; e estenderão sobre ele o propiciatório de peles finas, e lhe porão também as varas.

versos.hebraico: וְכִלָּ֣ה אַֽהֲרֹן־וּ֠בָנָיו לְכַסֹּ֨ת אֶת־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְאֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּדֶשׁ֮ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֒ וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן יָבֹ֤אוּ בְנֵי־קְהָת֙ לָשֵׂ֔את וְלֹֽא־יִגְּע֥וּ אֶל־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵ֑תוּ אֵ֛לֶּה מַשָּׂ֥א בְנֵֽי־קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: E em acabando Arão e seus filhos de cobrir o santuário e todos os vasos do santuário, quando o acampamento se houver de mudar, virão depois disso os filhos de Coate para conduzir: mas não tocarão coisa santa, que morrerão. Estas serão as cargas dos filhos de Coate no tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וּפְקֻדַּ֞ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר׀ בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמָּאוֹר֙ וּקְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֔ים וּמִנְחַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה פְּקֻדַּ֗ת כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֔וֹ בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָֽיו׃ס

controles.web: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
controles.kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
controles.livre: Porém ao cargo de Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, estará o azeite da luminária, e o incenso aromático, e a oferta de cereais contínua, e o azeite da unção; o cargo de todo o tabernáculo, e de tudo o que está nele, no santuário, e em seus utensílios.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּכְרִ֕יתוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֖בֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י מִתּ֖וֹךְ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
controles.kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
controles.livre: Não cortareis a tribo das famílias de Coate dentre os levitas;

versos.hebraico: וְזֹ֣את׀ עֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם וְחָיוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֔תוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּ֖ם אֶת־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ יָבֹ֔אוּ וְשָׂמ֣וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל־עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְאֶל־מַשָּׂאֽוֹ׃

controles.web: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them everyone to his service and to his burden;
controles.kjv: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
controles.livre: Mas isto fareis com eles, para que vivam, e não morram quando achegarem ao lugar santíssimo: Arão e seus filhos virão e os porão a cada um em seu ofício, e em seu cargo.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־יָבֹ֧אוּ לִרְא֛וֹת כְּבַלַּ֥ע אֶת־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵֽתוּ׃פ

controles.web: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
controles.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
controles.livre: Não entrarão para ver, quando cobrirem as coisas santas; que morrerão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés dizendo:

versos.hebraico: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן גַּם־הֵ֑ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
controles.kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
controles.livre: Toma também a conta dos filhos de Gérson pelas casas de seus pais, por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה עַ֛ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקֹ֣ד אוֹתָ֑ם כָּל־הַבָּא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֥ד עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old; all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: De idade de trinta anos acima até cinquenta anos os contarás; todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י לַעֲבֹ֖ד וּלְמַשָּֽׂא׃

controles.web: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
controles.kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
controles.livre: Este será o ofício das famílias de Gérson, para ministrar e para levar:

versos.hebraico: וְנָ֨שְׂא֜וּ אֶת־יְרִיעֹ֤ת הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמִכְסֵ֛ה הַתַּ֥חַשׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶ֨ת־מָסַ֔ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above on it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
controles.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
controles.livre: Levarão as cortinas do tabernáculo, e o tabernáculo do testemunho, sua coberta, e a coberta de peles finas que está sobre ele encima, e a cortina da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho,

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר וְאֶת־מָסַ֣ךְ׀ פֶּ֣תַח׀ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֤ן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתְרֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶֽת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֖י עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם וְעָבָֽדוּ׃

controles.web: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. Therein shall they serve.
controles.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
controles.livre: E as cortinas do átrio, e a cortina da porta do átrio, que está próxima do tabernáculo e próxima do altar ao redor, e suas cordas, e todos os instrumentos de seu serviço, e tudo o que será feito para eles: assim servirão.

versos.hebraico: עַל־פִּי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו תִּהְיֶ֗ה כָּל־עֲבֹדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֔י לְכָל־מַשָּׂאָ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וּפְקַדְתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵהֶם֙ בְּמִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת אֵ֖ת כָּל־מַשָּׂאָֽם׃

controles.web: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
controles.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
controles.livre: Segundo a ordem de Arão e de seus filhos será todo o ministério dos filhos de Gérson em todos os seus cargas, e em todo o seu serviço: e lhes atribuireis em responsabilidade todas as suas cargas.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּמִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃פ

controles.web: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
controles.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
controles.livre: Este é o serviço das famílias dos filhos de Gérson no tabernáculo do testemunho: e a responsabilidade deles estará sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֥ם לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖ם תִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
controles.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
controles.livre: Contarás os filhos de Merari por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה וְעַ֛ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקְדֵ֑ם כָּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de cinquenta anos, os contarás; todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וְזֹאת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת מַשָּׂאָ֔ם לְכָל־עֲבֹדָתָ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמּוּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
controles.kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
controles.livre: E este será o dever de seu cargo para todo seu serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho: as tábuas do tabernáculo, e suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases,

versos.hebraico: וְעַמּוּדֵי֩ הֶחָצֵ֨ר סָבִ֜יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֗ם וִֽיתֵדֹתָם֙ וּמֵ֣יתְרֵיהֶ֔ם לְכָל־כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וּבְשֵׁמֹ֣ת תִּפְקְד֔וּ אֶת־כְּלֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת מַשָּׂאָֽם׃

controles.web: and the pillars of the court around it, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden.
controles.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
controles.livre: E as colunas do átrio ao redor, e suas bases, e suas estacas, e suas cordas com todos os seus instrumentos, e todo seu serviço; e contareis por seus nomes todos os vasos da guarda de seu cargo.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י לְכָל־עֲבֹדָתָ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

controles.web: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
controles.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
controles.livre: Este será o serviço das famílias dos filhos de Merari para todo seu ministério no tabernáculo do testemunho, sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְקֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
controles.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
controles.livre: Moisés, pois, e Arão, e os chefes da congregação, contaram os filhos de Coate por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
controles.livre: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos; todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: Those who were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: E foram os contados deles por suas famílias, dois mil setecentos e cinquenta.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֤לֶּה פְקוּדֵי֙ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֔י כָּל־הָעֹבֵ֖ד בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: These are those who were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
controles.kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: Estes foram os contados das famílias de Coate, todos os que ministram no tabernáculo do testemunho, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, como o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וּפְקוּדֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Those who were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
controles.kjv: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
controles.livre: E os contados dos filhos de Gérson, por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
controles.livre: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: even those who were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.
controles.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
controles.livre: Os contados deles por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, foram dois mil seiscentos e trinta.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֗י מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֔וֹן כָּל־הָעֹבֵ֖ד בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: These are those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.
controles.livre: Estes são os contados das famílias dos filhos de Gérson, todos os que ministram no tabernáculo do testemunho, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão por ordem do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּפְקוּדֵ֕י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
controles.kjv: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
controles.livre: E os contados das famílias dos filhos de Merari, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais,

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
controles.livre: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: even those who were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
controles.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, por suas famílias, foram três mil e duzentos.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֔י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: These are those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
controles.kjv: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: Estes foram os contados das famílias dos filhos de Merari, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, segundo o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: All those who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
controles.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
controles.livre: Todos os contados dos levitas, que Moisés e Arão e os chefes de Israel contaram por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־הַבָּ֗א לַעֲבֹ֨ד עֲבֹדַ֧ת עֲבֹדָ֛ה וַעֲבֹדַ֥ת מַשָּׂ֖א בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
controles.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
controles.livre: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entravam para ministrar no serviço, e ter cargo de obra no tabernáculo do testemunho;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֖וּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁמֹנַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִֽים׃

controles.web: even those who were numbered of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
controles.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
controles.livre: Os contados deles foram oito mil quinhentos e oitenta,

versos.hebraico: עַל־פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה פָּקַ֤ד אוֹתָם֙ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל־עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְעַל־מַשָּׂא֑וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֕יו אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were numbered by Moses, everyone according to his service, and according to his burden. Thus were they numbered by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Como o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés foram contados, cada um segundo seu ofício, e segundo seu cargo; os quais contou ele, como lhe foi mandado.
